pasusi: I am writing about the Senior Python Engineer role at Example Technologies. I am a Python engineer with four years of production experience, and for the past two years I have designed and written a complete clinic management system that I now run as my own company, MAAT INNOVATIONS.

That system is the shortest answer to what I can do. It covers an entire healthcare provider rather than one department — scheduling, clinical records, laboratory, operating theatre, home visits, stock, equipment and finance — and I own every layer of it: the PostgreSQL schema and its migrations, the FastAPI services, role-based access across eight roles, encryption of personal and medical data at rest with blind-index search so encrypted fields stay searchable, PDF and e-mail delivery, and integrations with laboratory analysers over ASTM, FHIR export and fiscal receipts.

The part I would bring to a team is not the feature list but the habit behind it. Every defect that is found becomes a regression test that must fail on the old code before the fix is allowed to land, and the suite runs in CI on every push. The same discipline shows up in how the system treats money and medical records: nothing corrects itself silently, discrepancies are reported to a human, and every read of a patient record is written to an append-only trail.

Alongside that I work at LINK Group on ML-powered applications serving 50,000+ daily users, where I rewrote the data pipelines that carried a nightly run from four hours down to forty-five minutes and mentored five junior developers.

I would be glad to walk you through the system on a call — half an hour is enough to show it working rather than described. My CV is attached, and the product is at resadspahovic.com/maat-innovations.
